chunks: Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan narrated to me, from his father, from Dāwūd ibn Abī Yazīd al-ʿAṭṭār—and he is Dāwūd ibn Farqad—from Burayd ibn Muʿāwiyah al-ʿIjlī, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man has intercourse with his slave-girl in the water? He said: “There is no problem with it.”

key_terms.لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ: there is no harm or legal objection in it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible in Shia fiqh for a man to have intercourse in water?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal ruling from Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام regarding a man having intercourse with his slave-girl while in water. The Imam عليه السلام states that there is no objection to it, indicating permissibility in this specific case within the chapter on ghusl from janabah.
